en: Conditioned by a state that is neither a cause nor of the Asekha type, a state that is a cause and of the Sekha type arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither a cause nor of the Asekha type, a state that is a cause and of the Asekha type arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor of the neither-Asekha-nor-Aseka type, a state that is neither a cause nor of the neither-Asekha-nor-Aseka type arises.
Root condition. Dependent on a non-root dhamma that is neither-learner-nor-non-learner, there arises a non-root dhamma that is neither-learner-nor-non-learner by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; under predominance condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
